description:
MECHANISM (cold-reviewed 2026-08-31 at a0a92a8cb; every number reproduced
from the public telemetry stream, no probes; recipe at bottom): the
post-fz-kdt.84 zero-change analysis evals (72/43/37 on
00420/range_map/predicate) are ~90% FunctionContract-woken (65/30/33), and
those are NOT concluding re-runs -- they are the MIDDLE RUNG of a serialized
two-rung wait ladder inside one job. All 65/30/33 (100%, all three
fixtures) block again on Recursive/DispatchMask of the SAME callee, and
zero evals ever co-block on FunctionContract and the keying facts in one
run. Cause: refine_function_call_surface's early `return None` on a missing
contract (semantic.rs:1672) prevents prepare_function_call's
require_activation_key_facts (semantic.rs:1856 -> world.rs:1650) from being
reached in the same run. The job asks for rung 1, sleeps, wakes, asks for
rung 2, sleeps, wakes, publishes. This is a wait-registration sequencing
defect inside the job's own body -- not demand lateness.

## THE FIX: fold the callee's prerequisite asks into one ask (a deletion)

One `require_callee_prerequisites(world, function, reads, waits) -> bool`
registering contract readiness AND require_activation_key_facts in the same
pass, called once BEFORE refine_function_call_surface at all three resolve
sites (semantic.rs:1229 call_emission_for_function, :1305
resolve_function_call, :1453 resolve_protocol_call). Then:
- refine_function_call_surface (semantic.rs:1658) LOSES its
  wait-registration half -- becomes pure contract application.
- prepare_function_call (semantic.rs:1848) LOSES its own
  require_activation_key_facts call at :1856.
Net: two sequenced asks deleted, one fold replaces them (rip-out law:
the supersession and the deletion are one motion).

Order constraints: wait_for_unresolved_function_module stays first
(:1301/:1448); test function_is_provider_boundary (world.rs:1467,
contract-independent) BEFORE the ask so the boundary branch does not
acquire Recursive/DispatchMask reads it lacks today.

SOUNDNESS: waits are AND-satisfied (scheduler.rs:846; Current => presence),
so three waits collapse to one wake. No cycle: DeriveCallGraphComponent
needs StaticCallees+LoweredBody (keying.rs:191), DeriveDispatchMask reads
EntryDispatch (keying.rs:302), DeriveFunctionContract needs
FunctionDefined/TypeDefined/StructDefined/EntryDispatch -- none reads any
AnalyzeActivation output; all three expand at the same drain via
demand_blocked_wait_producers (drive.rs:376). Activation keys unchanged:
contract refinement still precedes activation_key in the run that finally
proceeds, so specialization width cannot move.

## RED-FIRST
Drive-altitude test: an analysis whose callee has neither contract nor
keying facts blocks ONCE with `blocked` naming FunctionContract(f),
Recursive(f), DispatchMask(f) TOGETHER, and re-runs exactly once. Today's
tree fails it (measured: 0 such co-blocks on all three fixtures).

## ACCEPTANCE
- Zero-change AnalyzeActivation evals 72/43/37 -> <=7/13/4 (re-pin the
  ANALYSIS_CLAIM_RATCHET zero-change column downward).
- FunctionContract-caused zero-change 65/30/33 -> 0; FunctionContract wakes
  66/30/33 -> 0.
- Canon byte-compare unchanged on all three fixtures; inventory pins hold
  at 59/221/214 (canon_test.rs:277) -- a movement there is a FINDING, not a
  re-pin (the determinism pair compares a build against itself and is blind
  to baseline shifts by construction; the stored-canon compare + pins are
  the real instruments).
- Determinism pair green; lib+cli+matrix green; zero-uncaused unweakened
  (bundling merges causes; it never removes an eval's named moved input).

## REFUTED DIRECTIONS (kill reasons, do not rebuild)
- PREFETCH AT IGNITION (this ticket's original design): provable no-op --
  0/0/0 self-blocks; Activation(key) is published only AFTER the callee's
  contract and keying facts exist (refine before prepare at all three
  sites; require_activation_key_facts returns None when absent; frontier
  fed only by complete_job/seed_root on that publish). The blocking
  prerequisites are CALLEE-local, discovered mid-walk, unknowable at
  ignition. Removes exactly 0 blocks.
- StaticCallees-scoped prefetch (the only coherent prefetch): pulls
  LowerFunction/PlanEntryDispatch for callees this activation's types never
  reach -- speculative heavy work traded for one wake. Wrong trade.
- Eager contract at DefineFunction: contracts are NOT cheap-local --
  DeriveFunctionContract blocks on EntryDispatch 51/20/22 of 111/48/51 runs
  (~1.8 runs/contract), which gates on lowering; deriving earlier blocks
  earlier, arrival time identical; ~31%+ waste on never-analyzed functions;
  and DefineFunction deciding by name that a contract is wanted breaks
  demand purity. (Corollary kept: DispatchMask also reads EntryDispatch --
  contract and mask share a prerequisite layer, which is exactly why
  bundling collapses the ladder instead of reordering it.)
- Read Current(FunctionContract) instead of waiting: UNSOUND -- unrefined
  input_types feed world.activation_key (semantic.rs:1861), minting a
  WIDER activation that is analyzed and joined into cumulative ReturnType
  with no retraction when the contract lands ("unknown is not none" at its
  most expensive). refine_contract_inputs narrowing is load-bearing for
  key identity.

Residual after this fix (measured oracle ceiling): evals woken only by
{FC,Rec,DM} are 185/68/99 (19%/26%/13%); after bundling, the remaining
120/38/66 are Rec/DM first-encounter arrivals, ALL PRODUCTIVE (one per
distinct activation x keying-callee pair: 125/39/66) -- that is legitimate
first-contact traffic, not a defect.

RECIPE: fz2 debug at branch HEAD, clean tree, interp lane,
`--log-telemetry F.jsonl` over fixtures2/00420_enum_take_drop_split.fz,
fixtures2/behavior/fz_f98_range_map_converges.fz,
fixtures2/behavior/enum_predicate_search.fz. Stream-order join over
fz.compiler2.work_graph.applied: fold wakes[] where
job.kind==AnalyzeActivation && disposition==enqueued into
pending[(root,fn,arrow)] += cause.kind; pop on each AnalyzeActivation
completion; classify first-run/productive/zero-change; read blocked[] for
the ladder join.
title: Fold the callee prerequisite asks into one: contract + keying waits registered together (deletes the two-rung ladder)
